emerging_technology: Indoor autonomous delivery robots: wheeled service robots that navigate indoor routes to carry meals or items to destinations
intended_application: Carry prepared meals from the kitchen to table-side handoff points; staff load trays and complete table service.
business_need: Reduce repetitive carrying without reducing seating or adding unaffordable supervision.
users_stakeholders: Owner, two service staff, diners and installation technician.
adoption_posture: Conservative / risk-averse organization, despite enthusiastic owner pressure
capabilities_constraints: Hypothetical assumptions: single level; a measured 55 cm bottleneck on the proposed route; movable chairs intrude further at peak times; limited budget; no dedicated robot attendant. The specific proposal is BellaBot Pro, with no approved layout change or alternative model assessment.
risk_consequence_context: A robot could obstruct the narrow route, increase interventions and reduce usable seating or service access.
management_question: Should this small restaurant buy the proposed delivery robot now because the owner calls the technology civilization-changing?
time_horizon: Purchase decision this month; revisit after a site/layout assessment; annual broad review over three years.
additional_context: Evidence snapshot 2026-10-22. All venue details are hypothetical assumptions, not observations at a named company.
